prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1109; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache radiating into the upper shoulders. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the impact, and the presenting symptoms are in keeping with a cervical strain pattern. No prior injury to the cervical spine or upper back is known from the history obtained. Conservative management was provided over 28 visits, including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instructions. Care extended somewhat beyond the typical course for this type of injury, with gradual improvement reported over time. Cervical range of motion, neurological screening, and palpation findings were largely within normal limits at each assessment, and cervical imaging showed no acute abnormality. Therefore, the clinical picture relies heavily on the patient's self-reported pain levels and functional limitations. Billing records reviewed for this episode reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered.
